Naraguta Hills Heritage Eco-Hike & Archery Rites

By Anaguta Tradomodern Media

A community expedition that brings together youths, tourists, and cultural enthusiasts to explore the rocky granite peaks of Naraguta.

What Happens

Guided hikes trace ancestral watchtower caves and natural defensive ridges, with live demonstrations of traditional archery by master hunters and environmental conservation awareness.
